headline: Police attacked, banned student leader freed from custody in Jhalokathi
summary: A mob of over 100 people, including relatives and supporters of a banned student leader, attacked police in Jhalokathi, freeing the suspect who was in handcuffs. Three officers were injured in the incident.
details: Police in Jhalokathi's Nalchity Upazila were attacked by a mob who freed a handcuffed, banned student leader named Siraj Molla. The incident occurred around 1 PM on Sunday at the old ferry ghat area of Dapdapiya. A police pickup van was also vandalized, and three police officers sustained injuries.

Siraj Molla, identified as the president of the banned student wing in Dapdapiya Union and a Union Parishad member, was arrested on Saturday afternoon on the basis of an arrest warrant for a case. Police sources confirmed he was a wanted fugitive.

Following Molla's arrest, his brothers—Sohael Molla, Jewel Molla, and Shahid Molla—led a group of over 100 individuals, including relatives and supporters of the banned Awami League faction, to attack the police. They managed to free Siraj Molla while he was still in handcuffs.

During the confrontation, a scuffle broke out as police attempted to prevent the escape. The attackers vandalized a police pickup van. Nalchity Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Touhiduzzaman Sohag confirmed that he and two other officers were injured in the assault. Police have launched a major operation to recapture Siraj Molla.

topic: crude bomb blasts at Dhaka University, three held
headline_marked: 6 crude bomb blasts hit [[Dhaka University campus]], 3 detained
headline: 6 crude bomb blasts hit Dhaka University campus, 3 detained
summary: Explosions were reported at six locations, including the metro rail station and Senate Building, leading to the detention of three suspects.
details: Crude bomb blasts rocked the Dhaka University campus on Tuesday evening, with explosions reported at six different locations around 6:42 pm.
The blasts occurred beneath the university's metro rail station, near the Senate Building, the Institute of Modern Languages, and in front of the University Laboratory School and College.
Additional explosions were reported at the Nilkhet intersection and near the Nilkhet gate.
Students caught two suspects following an explosion beneath the metro rail station and handed them over to the Shahbagh Police.
A third person was detained near the Nilkhet intersection and also handed over to the police.
The detained individuals have been identified as Rezaul Karim (42), Sohel Rana (33), and Najmus Saad (33).
Police officials stated that several individuals arrived by rickshaw near the 'Mukti O Ganatantra' gate near Nilkhet, detonated the bombs, and attempted to flee.
Dhaka University Proctor Prof Israfil Ratan confirmed that security surveillance across the campus has been stepped up following the incidents.
caption:
6 crude bomb blasts rocked the Dhaka University campus in a series of evening explosions.

Crude bomb blasts rocked the Dhaka University campus on Tuesday evening, with explosions reported at six different locations around 6:42 pm.

The blasts occurred beneath the university's metro rail station, near the Senate Building, the Institute of Modern Languages, and in front of the University Laboratory School and College.

Additional explosions were reported at the Nilkhet intersection and near the Nilkhet gate.

Students caught two suspects following an explosion beneath the metro rail station and handed them over to the Shahbagh Police.

A third person was detained near the Nilkhet intersection and also handed over to the police.

The detained individuals have been identified as Rezaul Karim (42), Sohel Rana (33), and Najmus Saad (33).

Police officials stated that several individuals arrived by rickshaw near the 'Mukti O Ganatantra' gate near Nilkhet, detonated the bombs, and attempted to flee.

Dhaka University Proctor Prof Israfil Ratan confirmed that security surveillance across the campus has been stepped up following the incidents.
